verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Orb serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.withorb.com that indexes markdown versions of its docs pages. The OpenAPI spec is also listed under an "OpenAPI Specs" section of that llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated full-content agent bundle, and no independent hands-on report of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.withorb.com/llms.txt # Orb
Orb publishes its full OpenAPI 3.1 document on the docs domain (listed under "## OpenAPI Specs" in the docs llms.txt)
